I re-checked the schedule against all 20 constraints, and every one holds:

| Slot | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Person | Hana | Finn | Cara | Ben | Ann | Gus | Elif | Ivo | Dev |

The adjacency and "exactly one between" constraints are the tightest. Finn is right after Hana (2 after 1), Gus is right after Ann (6 after 5), exactly one person sits between Cara and Hana (slot 2), and exactly one sits between Dev and Elif (slot 8). The gap constraints also hold: Ben–Dev is 5, Elif–Hana is 6, Ann–Ivo is 3, Dev–Finn is 7, Cara–Elif is 4, Ann–Finn is 3, and Ann–Dev is 4.

I did not check whether this is the only valid schedule. The task asks for a schedule, so one that satisfies every constraint is enough.
